cannot be adjusted or discounted

description:
An elegant late-1950s Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust, reference 6604, with a stainless-steel case and link bracelet complemented by an 18K red-gold-plated bezel and crown. The silver-tone sunburst dial is accented with applied baton hour markers, luminous plots, gold-tone hands, and a central seconds hand. A date aperture at 3 o’clock, magnified by the Cyclops lens, displays the date “25.” The dial is signed “Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust” and “Officially Certified Chronometer.”

Introduced in 1945, the Datejust brought together Rolex’s self-winding movement, chronometer certification, and date display at 3 o’clocka combination that became an enduring signature of the model.  This example weighs approximately 76.28 grams and has been verified by a jeweler.

Missouri Meerschaum / Hirschl & Bendheim
Corn Cob Pipe Wood Display Plaque
Hardwood, Brass, Corn Cob, Approximately 7.25 x 5 Inches
Vintage tobacciana display plaque celebrating Washington, Missouri's historic legacy as the corn cob pipe capital of the world. The finished dark wood mount features an engraved brass plaque titled "An American Heritage - the original Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Pipe," paired with an authentic corn cob pipe held securely by a metal spring clip. The pipe's bowl retains its original green Hirschl & Bendheim factory label on the underside, representing one of Missouri Meerschaum's most storied historical contemporaries.
Beveled dark-stained wood display plaque with black metal spring retaining clip
Engraved brass nameplate featuring the official Missouri Meerschaum company seal
Corn cob pipe featuring a textured shank, metal ferrule, and amber-colored bit
Original green paper label on pipe base marked Hirschl & Bendheim, Washington, Missouri
Plaque measures approximately 7.25 inches wide by 5 inches tall
Condition:
Wood plaque is structurally sound with light edge wear and minor finish scuffs. Brass plate is securely attached with light surface patina. Pipe shows bowl interior darkening and charring consistent with prior use. Exterior cob bowl and amber stem show light handling wear. Underside factory sticker is intact and legible.

Title:
Polished Rocks Minerals Crystals Fossil Shark Teeth Collection Lot
Condition:
Used
Condition Description:
Bundle in used condition, cleaned and handled
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Dimension:
10 x 10 x 10 in
Description:
This collector's bundle features an intriguing mix of loose polished rocks, various mineral specimens, crystal clusters, and fossil fragments, providing broad appeal for geology enthusiasts and educators. Among the assortment are a striking triangular purple crystal cluster resembling amethyst, a large cream-colored crystal matrix, a long translucent white mineral specimen with fibrous striations, and a clear pointed crystal. Other notable pieces include a lustrous golden-brown banded stone, a turquoise-green mineral set on a beige matrix, a rough smaller purple cluster, and a polished gray-lavender slab with mustard veining and open cavities. Fossil interest is added by several dark triangular fragments likely fossil shark teeth, and a selection of multicolored tumbled stones in a small clear bag. All pieces are loose and suited for educational display, personal mineral collections, or hands-on learning. Surfaces range from polished and glossy to granular and rough, with no visible damage or major flaws. The bundle shows standard signs of handling and prior cleaning. An excellent introduction to the hobby of rock and mineral collecting.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97

All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. description:
Petrified Wood Specimens
Natural Fossilized Wood Lot
Set of 3 Pieces
This collection features three distinct pieces of natural petrified wood displaying unique mineralized grain patterns and organic textures. Petrified wood forms over millions of years through permineralization, where organic wood material is replaced by silicate minerals while retaining the original cellular structure. These specimen pieces offer excellent aesthetic appeal for display, geological study, or natural decor.
Items Included:
One elongated dark specimen with prominent weathered bark texture and white mineral accents
One smooth, rounded oval specimen featuring visible wood grain and light tan coloration
One rounded cylindrical piece with weathered grain striations in neutral driftwood tones
Condition:
Natural rough and weathered specimen condition. Each piece retains organic edges, natural mineral striations, and surface fissures consistent with fossilization and natural weathering. No artificial alterations, cracks from impact, or post-extraction damage observed.

description:
Fossilized Megalodon Shark Tooth
Natural Mineralized Fossil Specimen
Prehistoric, Miocene to Pliocene Epoch
This authentic fossilized shark tooth originates from the prehistoric apex predator
Otodus megalodon
, which inhabited oceans during the Miocene and Pliocene epochs. The specimen displays preserved enamel with natural gradient coloration, an intact bourrelet chevron, and fine serrations along the lateral cutting edges supported by a dense root matrix.
Authentic prehistoric megalodon shark tooth fossil
Preserved serrated cutting edges with intact chevron bourrelet
Mineralized brown and tan coloration with gloss enamel finish
Dimensions: approximately 5.5" W x 4.5" L x 2.0" H; weight: 0.68 lbs
Condition:
Good fossil condition with wear consistent with geological age and mineralization. Displays visible surface cracking and natural enamel fissures across the blade and root. Serrations remain well defined with minor edge wear. Solid specimen with no signs of restoration.

Description
: Enhance your home or office with this striking pair of bookends crafted from natural agate stone. Boasting a unique combination of crystal and banded hues in brown, amber, white, and cream, each bookend offers distinctively cut and polished surfaces on one side and natural rough stone on the other. The varied banding and crystal formations within each half elevate the look, ensuring no two pieces are exactly alike. These bookends are both functional and decorative, sturdy enough to hold your books securely while serving as an eye-catching accent piece. Measuring approximately 6 to 7 inches tall, they are sized conveniently for shelf, desk, or tabletop display. The item is in visible good condition, with minor natural variations and surface inconsistencies consistent with stone material. Bring organic elegance and durability to your space by displaying these agate bookends, perfect for collectors or anyone seeking a blend of beauty and practicality. Only the pair of agate bookends shown is included

Armstrong & Whitall Tatum
Clear, Mid-20th Century
This pair of vintage pressed glass insulators represents classic American communications infrastructure from the mid-20th century. This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark.
